g.textArea: One run on one day: bags round up to whole mixes, minutes follow, and Asset puts the run on Breadline or MCS.

K4 (Mix-Slice-Oven!K4): the day for Planned Total and O1/O2, typed. This week Tuesday.
DoughWeight lb per SKU and day; Dough Weight (Dough I) = lb in one bag.
Scrap Factor (Products); optimal bags per mix and Run Time Per Mix (Unique Dough Optimal Bag and Optimal Time).
Asset (Products): Breadline or Breadline/Artisan = Breadline; MCS LINE = MCS.

L Dough Weight =IFERROR(ROUND(LET(d,MATCH($K$4,{"Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"},0),XLOOKUP([@Sku],DoughWeight[Sku],CHOOSE(d,DoughWeight[Sun],DoughWeight[Mon],DoughWeight[Tue],DoughWeight[Wed],DoughWeight[Thur],DoughWeight[Fri]))/XLOOKUP([@Dough],Dough[No.],Dough[Weight])),2)*[@Scrap Factor],"")
N Optimal Total =IFERROR(IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D",SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[Optimal Total],Mix_Slice[Dough],[@Sku],Mix_Slice[Asset],D8),IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),CEILING([@Bags By Unique Dough],[@optimal bags per mix])*2.5,CEILING([@Bags By Unique Dough],[@optimal bags per mix]))),"")
S_Minutes =IF(LEFT([@Sku],1)="D","",IFERROR(([@S_Planned]/[@optimal bags per mix])*[@Run Time Per Mix (min)]/IF(OR([@Unique Dough]="Marble Hearth",[@Unique Dough]="Marble Lg Pullman"),2.5,1),0))
O1 Breadline / O2 MCS bags =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[Planned Total],Mix_Slice[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"})); =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[Planned Total],Mix_Slice[Asset],"MCS LINE"))
Row 1 Breadline, Sunday bags =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[S_Planned],Mix_Slice[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"})), hours =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[S_Minutes],Mix_Slice[Asset],{"Breadline","Breadline/Artisan"}))/60
Row 2 MCS, Sunday bags =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[S_Planned],Mix_Slice[Asset],"MCS LINE")), hours =SUM(SUMIFS(Mix_Slice[S_Minutes],Mix_Slice[Asset],"MCS LINE"))/60

Breadline: Challah 3 Braided, Tuesday: M 1.298 bags, 1 bag per mix: N = 2, Planned 2, minutes 2 / 1 x 30 = 60.
MCS: 6" Italian Rolls, Tuesday: M 8.415 bags, 4 bags per mix: N = 12, 3 mixes x 20 min = 60.
Breadline Marble Hearth, Tuesday: M 1.672: CEILING = 2, x 2.5 = 5 bags; minutes 5 / 1 x 45 / 2.5 = 90.
Breadline by day: bags Sun 48, Mon 50.5, Tue 54.5, Wed 53.5, Thu 76.5, Fri 135.5; hours Sun 8.5, Mon 7.25, Tue 9.92, Wed 9.2, Thu 13.08, Fri 22.7.
MCS by day: bags Sun 174, Mon 200, Tue 180, Wed 188, Thu 219, Fri 255; hours Sun 16.08, Mon 18.58, Tue 16.92, Wed 17.5, Thu 20.42, Fri 25.25.
K4 day (Tuesday): O1 54.5 and O2 180 bags, the same as row 1 and row 2 Tuesday.

Should K4 follow today's date by default, and should there be a K4-day hours cell next to O1 and O2?
Should MCS changeover minutes, which exist only on the MCS Schedule, count in the MCS hours?
The per-day blocks round after scrap while L rounds before: which is intended?
Should Extra Bread (Runout) in column X add to the bags before they are rounded up?
